{{NPC Infobox |image = NPC Cameron.png |type = Open-World |nation = Rinascita |location = Fool's Elysium |group = |affiliation = Troupe of Fools |title = |ancestry = |father = |mother = |spouse = |sibling = |child = |relative = |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} '''Cameron''' is a male NPC who appears in {{Location|Fool's Elysium|nocat=1}} at 18:00-05:59.
It's implied he may be a Resonator that can peer into and "craft" dreams for others. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Idle== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(From the people sleeping nearby) :;'''Knox''' I love you... but I can only see you in my dreams... :;'''Knox''' Look at our daughter... how adorable s he is... Marina :;'''Knox''' Can I see her one last time, please... Why... Why can't I see her face clearly... :;'''Knox''' Marina... Marina...? :;'''Gideon''' I get what you're saying... but I want a No. 65 Tubpup with Nuvola Pasta... :;'''Gideon''' It's so deep... It's all Troupe Strength in the Tubpup... I can't drink anymore... :;'''Gideon''' Too much Tubpup... bad for your health... :;'''Todd''' Ragunna... the false Righteous One... cloaked in divinity, divinity... hmm... :;'''Todd''' Father... Mother... It's me, Todd... Did you like my performance...? :;'''Todd''' Don't cry... I'm here... I'm home... ==Dialogue== :'''Cameron:''' Can't sleep either? :{{DIcon}} What's keeping you up? :'''Cameron:''' As you can see, it's only when I'm fully awake that I can "craft" their dreams. :{{DIcon}} What kind of dreams do you craft? :'''Cameron:''' Hmm… it varies, really. Most of the time, I create beautiful visions to heal the regrets that weigh on their hearts. :'''Cameron:''' But, from what I've seen, the fear of "boarding the Fool's Sail" appears to be so deeply rooted that the dreams don't always turn out as they hoped. :{{DIcon}} What are their regrets? :'''Cameron:''' Todd, hailing from an underground theater troupe, was banished merely for using comedy to satirize the Order's tax policies... :'''Cameron:''' Gideon's family was framed by the Acolytes. At his lowest, he could only find solace with a Tubpup. It became his shelter, his only home in the storm. :'''Cameron:''' Knox was sent aboard the Fool's Sail before his newborn child even had a chance to open their eyes. And as kin of a "heretic," the future doesn't look kind. :{{DIcon}} So that's how it is... :'''Cameron:''' During this Carnevale, we all have to hide our identities and take on roles in the Fool's Troupe as we return to Ragunna City, after so long. :'''Cameron:''' We must suppress our desire to reconnect with old friends while trying to complete the Montelli family's mission. It's... complicated. So insomnia, I suppose, is inevitable. :'''Cameron:''' That's why I need to create dreams for them, to help them get some rest. :{{DIcon}} Why do you hide your true identities? :'''Cameron:''' Well, the Order doesn't know... but most of the Fool's Troupe are survivors from the Pilgrim's Sail. :'''Cameron:''' The moment the Order uncovers the truth, our Fool's Elysium will burn to the ground. We have to keep our silence, no matter the cost. :'''Cameron:''' In our plays, we sing to condemn the oppression, to shed light on the bloodshed… One day, all of Rinascita will know what Fenrico has done. :{{DIcon}} Take a break when you feel ready. :'''Cameron:''' Thank you… for taking the time to understand us, for wanting to know the Fools' story. ---- ;(After {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}}) {{Spoiler}} :'''Cameron:''' You're here again. :{{DIcon}} Crafting dreams again? :'''Cameron:''' More and more people can't fall asleep these days. :'''Cameron:''' It's already a struggle to accept being sent to the Pilgrim's Sail... and just when they finally made peace with it, the Dark Tide rose. :'''Cameron:''' Those who thought they could live in the present—accepting what fate dealt them—found their regrets surging back to the surface. :'''Cameron:''' I can't do much for them. But at the very least, I can give them one good night's sleep. :{{DIcon}} But that means you'll sleep less yourself. :'''Cameron:''' Fenrico's vanished. The Blessed Maiden has returned. And we're staring down an entirely new chapter. :'''Cameron:''' With so much happening, people are drowning in news and uncertainty, unsure where their lives are headed. :'''Cameron:''' I'm no different. So, to live in the present with a clear mind... That, to me, is a blessing in itself. {{Dialogue End}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Cameron |zhs = 卡梅隆 |zht = 卡梅隆 |ja = カメロン |ko = 카멜론 |es = Cameron |fr = Cameron |de = Cameron }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.0}}
